## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care completed 52 captures during December 2018. This report summarises activity for the month and records the outcome of the image review and grading process. The reported activity provides a clear account of the number of captures submitted from the site during the reporting period. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Image quality

Of the 52 captures completed, 1 was assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.9 per cent of captures. The finding is recorded separately from grading outcomes so that image quality can be monitored independently. The result indicates that most captures were suitable for review during the reporting period.

## Grading

The grading review identified 4 referable results. The median grading lag was 7 days. This measure records the midpoint time between capture and completion of grading and should be considered alongside the referable result count and the image-quality measure. Together, these figures provide the site-level position for December 2018 and support routine monitoring of service activity, image quality and grading timeliness at Oakridge Primary Care.
